transport: non-PTY stdio NDJSON; one watched pane per process

flags.--socket: Herdr Unix socket; defaults to HERDR_SOCKET_PATH

capabilities.claude_timeline: true when transcript root is available; per-pane source validation still required
capabilities.codex_timeline: true when the Codex root exists; prompts/approvals/questions/routed_hosts stay false
capabilities.record_content: true; rich entries and bounded content retrieval are enabled only when initialize params.record_content is true

subcommands.herdcats-bridge codex-config daemon-stat: Reports running/not_running/unknown state of the managed daemon and updater, and config.toml auto_start setting; exits 0 and prints JSON
subcommands.herdcats-bridge codex-config disable-dae: Sets features.daemon_auto_start = false in Codex config.toml; with --stop-running, also safely stops the running managed daemon and updater (note: stopping disconnects sessions attached to the daemon, which must be restarted); exits 0 and prints status/error JSON whose optional daemon/updater fields are one of stopped, not_running, stop_failed, unknown (unknown = a possibly-matching process is alive but its identity could not be verified; it is never signalled)

params.record_content: optional bool; false by default for older clients

requests.effect: clears watch; validates Herdr protocol22; required before other methods

params.before: stable first entry ID from preceding page

requests.effect: revalidates source before serving; may emit notifications before response

params.content_ref: opaque source reference published on an entry

requests.effect: Revalidates native occupant and source; returns at most64KiB raw bytes encoded as lowercase hex. Only current retained entry references are readable; no host paths accepted.

failure.id: request ID or null for invalid frame/ID

client_scope: Also bind to SSH host, Herdr session and local connection generation; those are not emitted by this helper.

timeline.snapshot.effect: replace state; recent page only; fetch earlier retained entries separately

timeline.updated.effect: Remove evicted_ids before stable-ID upserts; retention does not reset generation. Do not resurrect evicted IDs from delayed history. Counters may update with no entries; frames remain bounded.

timeline.unavailable.effect: clear selected timeline and invalidate cursors. For Codex panes with session_reference_unavailable, ambiguous_session or invalid_session_reference, data carries codex_daemon ('running' | 'not_running' | 'unknown'). Stopping the daemon disconnects active sessions attached to it, which must be restarted.

entry_fields.id: message:<source UUID>, tool:<tool ID>, or content:<source byte offset>:<block index>
entry_fields.kind: message/tool; image/record when record_content is negotiated
entry_fields.truncated: boolean, conservatively preserved for replayed tools
entry_fields.content_ref: optional opaque reference to complete block bytes
entry_fields.record_refs: optional references to complete original record bytes; up to4 per entry

reconnect: No persistent replay cursor. Start a new helper, initialize and watch. Epoch change or sequence gap requires fresh snapshot. Notifications can interleave all replies.
cursor: Generation-bound before entry ID. Identity/source replacement or genuine outage recovery resets generation. Normal retention keeps generation; a retained cursor remains valid and an evicted cursor returns stale_cursor.

limits.oversized_source_record_behavior: Complete source lines exceeding the parsed record limit use bounded typed deserialization for text/tools. Negotiated rich mode additionally emits image descriptors and unfamiliar-record bubbles with complete source references, without embedding bulky image bytes in live frames. Incomplete lines wait for newline; the 64MiB source bound remains hard.

source_policy: Herdr22 Claude reference source herdr:claude; native UUID exact filename/path beneath pinned transcript root; ambiguity, symlinks, missing reference or foreign main-session records fail closed.
implementation_limits: Bounded source prefix reread on change, new complete records parsed incrementally.
Negotiated content retrieval covers complete original records and blocks within the verified 64MiB source; only references on retained entries are readable.
Claude captured2.1.296 schema coverage; no general version promise.
Optional four-platform installer and native iOS client; Codex and native approval/question actions remain unavailable.
transient_read_behavior: source_changing retries without clearing verified cache for the same identity; after repeated retries (threshold 10), emits timeline.updated with delayed: true while keeping verified history until recovery clears it. A changed occupant still clears old state.
